# Demo scenarios (SIMULATED; output generated by the actual pipeline)

## DEMO 1 - Bank/KYC phishing

**Input:** Dear customer, your SBI account will be blocked today. Update your KYC immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.example.com/verify

**Detection:** Risk **HIGH** (score 0.925) | Potential Bank/KYC Scam | language: english | top model class `bank_kyc` at probability 0.969

**Evidence:**

- [low] Impersonation: “SBI”
- [high] Threat / Pressure: “will be blocked”
- [medium] Urgency: “immediately”
- URL [low] Many hyphens in domain: sbi-kyc-update.example.com
- URL [medium] No HTTPS: http://
- URL [low] Sensitive keyword in URL: kyc
- URL [high] Look-alike / brand misuse: 'sbi' in sbi-kyc-update.example.com

**Explanation:** The message shows: impersonation, threat / pressure, urgency. The link has suspicious characteristics: many hyphens in domain, no https, sensitive keyword in url, look-alike / brand misuse.

**Recommended action:** Banks do not ask you to update KYC through links in SMS. Open your bank's official app or visit a branch to check.

## DEMO 2 - Fake job/internship scam

**Input:** Congratulations Arun! You are selected for work from home at TechNova Solutions. Pay a refundable registration fee of Rs. 999 to confirm your joining. https://bit.ly/3xJobNow

**Detection:** Risk **HIGH** (score 0.825) | Potential Job/Internship Scam | language: english | top model class `job_internship` at probability 0.977

**Evidence:**

- [medium] Reward / too-good-to-be-true: “Congratulations”
- [medium] Job-offer lure: “work from home”
- [high] Payment request: “Pay a refundable registration fee”
- URL [medium] URL shortener: bit.ly

**Explanation:** The message shows: reward / too-good-to-be-true, job-offer lure, payment request.

**Recommended action:** Genuine employers do not charge fees to hire you. Verify the company on its official careers page before replying.

## DEMO 3 - UPI/payment scam

**Input:** You have received a collect request of Rs. 5,000. Approve it and enter your UPI PIN to receive the refund within 10 minutes.

**Detection:** Risk **HIGH** (score 0.999) | Potential UPI/Payment Scam | language: english | top model class `upi_payment` at probability 0.984

**Evidence:**

- [high] Payment request: “collect request”
- [high] Payment request: “Approve it”
- [high] Sensitive information request: “enter your UPI PIN”
- [medium] Urgency: “within 10 minutes”

**Explanation:** The message shows: payment request, sensitive information request, urgency.

**Recommended action:** Never approve a collect request or scan a QR code to RECEIVE money. Receiving money never needs your PIN.
